description:
What is This Part?
This is the Drive Shaft Sliding Yoke for the Intermediate Drive Shaft
It comes with a New Universal Joint & Qty 4 – Cir-clips
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Sliding Yoke
Qty 1 – Universal Joint
Qty 4 – Cir-clips
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
